topic_thesis: Financial influencers are turning normal gold market corrections into apocalyptic panic porn, scaring everyday investors into selling at the exact wrong time.
strategic_angle: Expose the pure clickbait math behind viral YouTube thumbnails screaming 'Gold to 11,000 Rupees!', showing how panic-peddling technical analysts farm views at the cost of your life savings.
target_emotion: Cynical disbelief at social media fearmongering
pinned_comment_text: Have you ever panicked and sold because of a YouTube thumbnail? Drop a 'YES' below, or comment 'GUIDE' to get our zero-nonsense bullion and asset safety checklist! 💬👇
tamil_adaptation_directive: Localize the middle-class gold obsession in Tamil Nadu. Use punchy Tanglish like 'Gold price drop aana odane panic aagi sell panradhu yaaru?', and mock the YouTube thumbnails shouting 'Thangam romba mosam aaga pogudhu!' with high-energy street cynicism.
